text: You know that moment when everybody at game night is on their phone? Or the game drags on so long the kids give up. This is Throw Hands. It's rock, paper, scissors with cards, and nobody takes turns. Watch the last card and slam down the one that beats it. Rock beats scissors, paper beats rock, scissors beats paper. First one out of cards wins. The only problem? A round is sixty seconds, so nobody stops at one. Girls, Thanksgiving is coming. It's two to eight players, so grab one for your house and one for grandma's. It's in the orange cart.
